en.title: Repair a tray sign
en.statement: The program runs, but the sign starts with a lowercase t. Repair the message so it prints Tray ready. Keep the output operation intact and change only the incorrect message character.
hints: Compare the first character of the required message with the starter message.
The first word must start with an uppercase T; the remaining letters are already correct.
Replace the lowercase t inside the quotes with T, leaving Tray ready as the message.
